title: Applicability of the Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program
previewText: For the purposes of applying the Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Program provisions set forth in Section 27-10 (ADMINISTRATION OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING), Mandatory Inclusionary Housing areas within the Special Eastchester – East Tremont Corridor District are shown in APPENDIX F of this Resolution.
